title: Geologic map of the Pickens quadrangle, Pickens County, South Carolina
citation: Garihan, J.M., Ranson, W.A., and Clendenin, C.W., Jr., 2008, Geologic map of the Pickens quadrangle, Pickens County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-41, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd Inner Piedmont map sheet; map face is OCR noise. Four cross sections (A-A' to D-D', no vertical exaggeration, sea level) of crystalline thrust sheets with faults, no drill holes; not traced from images; only names, datum and legible unit labels recorded (section C-C' and D-D' names read from end labels, inferred). OCR misreads: 'Microcline augen ... average | to 2 centimeters' left in description only; 'Jn' read as Jr. Faults named in the explanation and on sections recorded; legend-only fault and fold types not recorded. Several symbols garbled ('[Ans', 'Az', 'ines'). SUBSURFACE: crystalline sections with fault geometry only; no unit tops or bases.
